observed: Riot's official Legends of Runeterra Atakhan illustration depicts a unique looming shadow entity, ragged mantle, elongated clawed arms, crimson accents and a distinctive tall armoured crown/head silhouette.
The illustration does not establish a canonical recruitable species, two-hex footprint, walking/flight combat rules or a troop upgrade taxonomy.
The illustration has no ordinary feathered or drake wings. Do not infer flying capability or natural wing anatomy from this image.
New project rigs use independent hunched bodies, restrained bindings and a smaller lower head. Do not reproduce the illustration's unique crown, host/regalia, composition or pixels.

primary_text_sources_read.bounded_fact: LeBlanc freed Atakhan after more than 1000 years of imprisonment; he feeds on carnage and bloodshed.
LeBlanc and the Black Rose recaptured Atakhan; Thornbound represents capture; Bloody Roses spawn near his pit. This does not assert flight or thorn-wing anatomy.

troop_lore: Ruin Bringer and Greater Ruin Bringer are an invented bound-demon contingent and stronger manifestation. They are not Atakhan copies or canonical plural species.
redistribution: Not granted; private read-only reference excluded from active asset outputs.
